children.title: Cycle 20 · Synthesis of Meta-Reasoning and Preference Formation Insights

detail.title: Synthesis of Meta-Reasoning and Preference Formation Insights
detail.summary: This cycle integrates findings from path-dependent belief updating into meta-reasoning frameworks. Evaluation of foundational assumptions now incorporates evidence on how misspecified model regimes generate non-systematic preference structures, advancing the governance of automated metareasoning.
